part.name: Combination wrench with open jaw, ring end, and recessed handle panel

part_functions.name: Fastener turning
part_functions.function: Transfers hand-applied torque through either the open jaw or the closed ring interface to rotate hexagonal fasteners.

part_functions.name: Dual fastener access
part_functions.function: Provides an open-ended interface for lateral engagement and a closed ring interface for more complete fastener retention.

part_functions.name: Manual load transmission
part_functions.function: The elongated monolithic shank carries bending and torsional loads between the user's grip and either wrench head.

section_functions.name: Structural integration
section_functions.function: The continuous top and bottom plate surfaces structurally unite the ring head, handle, and open jaw into one 15 mm thick solid.

section_functions.name: Bending resistance
section_functions.function: The separated top and bottom surfaces form the extreme fibers of the wrench section and resist bending during torque application.

feature_functions.name: Top load-bearing skin
feature_functions.function: Provides the primary top surface over the heads and shank, surrounds the ring opening and handle recess, and connects all planform regions.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Large top planar face at y=15 spanning the complete wrench profile, with boundaries for the ring bore and recessed handle panel.

feature_functions.name: Bottom load-bearing skin
feature_functions.function: Provides a flat underside and works with the top face and peripheral walls to maintain the wrench's plate-like stiffness.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Large uninterrupted bottom planar face at y=0 spanning the complete wrench and surrounding the ring bore.

section_functions.name: Retained fastener engagement
section_functions.function: The circular opening surrounds a fastener or mating cylindrical element, reducing the likelihood of lateral disengagement compared with the open jaw.

section_functions.name: Load distribution
section_functions.function: The annular head distributes contact forces around the closed opening and blends those forces into both sides of the handle.

features.name: Ring head outer crown and neck blends

feature_functions.name: Ring reinforcement
feature_functions.function: The enlarged rounded crown supplies material around the closed opening, while the two radius blends transfer torque into the left and right handle rails.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Left 5 mm radius neck blend joining the left handle side to the outer ring crown near the positive-Z end.
Main convex cylindrical perimeter of the rounded ring head, approximately 14.92 mm in radius.
Right 5 mm radius neck blend joining the outer ring crown back to the right handle side.

feature_functions.name: Fastener interface
feature_functions.function: The through cylindrical opening is coaxial with the ring head and retains the engaged fastener around its circumference through the full part thickness.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Through-bore wall of the 10 mm radius circular opening centered near z=10 and extending from y=0 to y=15.

section_functions.name: Manual leverage
section_functions.function: The long central shank separates the two working heads and provides leverage for applying torque.

section_functions.name: Head-to-head structural connection
section_functions.function: The parallel side rails transmit axial, bending, and torsional loads between the closed ring end and open jaw.

section_functions.name: Surface relief
section_functions.function: The shallow top recess removes a small amount of material and provides a bounded grip, label, or decorative panel while retaining a raised perimeter frame.

feature_functions.name: Left-side load path
feature_functions.function: Forms one longitudinal edge of the shank and carries load between the left-side blends of the two wrench heads.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Long left vertical side face of the handle between approximately z=-96.47 and z=-2.01.

feature_functions.name: Right-side load path
feature_functions.function: Forms the opposing longitudinal edge of the shank and works with the left rail and broad faces to resist bending and twisting.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Long right vertical side face of the handle between approximately z=-96.37 and z=-2.12.

feature_functions.name: Grip and identification panel
feature_functions.function: Creates a 1 mm deep recessed field on the top of the handle that may improve tactile indexing or accommodate markings while its rounded corners reduce stress concentration.

feature_functions.name: Raised perimeter retention
feature_functions.function: The recess sidewalls retain any insert, coating, or label placed in the panel and preserve raised rails along the handle edges.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Short transverse wall at the positive-Z end of the shallow handle recess.
One 1 mm radius corner wall connecting the positive-Z end wall to the left longitudinal recess wall.
Long left longitudinal wall of the recessed handle panel.
One 1 mm radius corner wall connecting the left recess wall to the negative-Z end wall.
Short transverse wall at the negative-Z end of the shallow handle recess.
One 1 mm radius corner wall connecting the negative-Z end wall to the right longitudinal recess wall.
Long right longitudinal wall of the recessed handle panel.
One 1 mm radius corner wall connecting the right recess wall back to the positive-Z end wall.
Flat floor of the rounded-rectangle recess at y=14, one millimeter below the top body face.

section_functions.name: Lateral fastener access
section_functions.function: The U-shaped mouth permits a fastener to enter from the negative-Z end without passing axially through a closed ring.

section_functions.name: Opposed jaw loading
section_functions.function: The two symmetric jaw arms react force on opposite sides of an engaged fastener and transfer the resulting torque through curved outer shoulders into the handle.

features.name: Open-jaw arms, mouth, and head-to-handle transitions

feature_functions.name: Open fastener interface
feature_functions.function: The two parallel inner jaw faces guide and contact the fastener, while the rounded mouth root relieves stress and the enlarged curved exterior stiffens both arms.

feature_functions.name: Torque transfer into handle
feature_functions.function: The left and right transition fillets connect the broad open head to the narrow shank and reduce local stress concentration under jaw loading.

feature_functions.name: Bilateral structural balance
feature_functions.function: Left and right jaw surfaces are approximately symmetric about the longitudinal center plane and provide opposed, balanced load paths.
